name: project_hero
title: Project Hero
summary: Top of a project page: title, intro, meta and visual stage.
description: Top of a project page (the h1): eyebrow (type + date), the title (first word on its own line, the last word in the post color), the SEO description, two buttons, meta (website: Platform / Scope / Status) or stats (media: photos / videos / galleries), and a stage on the right: project_hero_stage_website (browser + phone) or project_hero_stage_media (window + square + video card), else the thumbnail in a frame. Background: grid lines + a glow in the post color. Also holds what the stages share: the frame colors (--hero-frame*), the stage base and its tag.
